body: Part A (BSE SHP XBRL filed before T): Gitanjali 79%, IL&FS Transportation 98%, Gensol 63%, Cox & Kings 54%, Zee 46%, Future 44%, Reliance Capital 34%, Luckin founders' margin loans; winners flagged: Apollo 71% (2019), Suzlon 76% (Dec-2019, then ~49x). Part B (Mar-2020 SHP, 452 firms): >25% flagged 68: loss50 2.9% vs 1.6% (p 0.34), x3 69% vs 51% (p 0.006); >50% flagged 44: loss50 4.5% vs 1.5%, x3 70%. Restricted to mcap >= Rs 400 cr at T0: >50% pledge loss50 10% (2/20, Sadbhav Engg/Infra) vs 1.4% (p 0.053). Verdict: KEEP GRADED (escalate at >50% or rising); never hard.
title: Promoter pledge >25% is the best graded flag pre-T (traps 8/20 vs winners 2/13) but in the 2020 universe pledged firms tripled MORE often; pledge >50% in firms >= Rs 400 cr: 10% vs 1.4% >50% losses (p 0.05, n=2)
